_note: Phase 5 audio. Every billable ElevenLabs call in this phase is logged in generations, including the ones that were rejected and regenerated. creditsMeasured is a before and after delta on /v1/usage/character-stats?breakdown_type=product_type, not an estimate. Written by scripts/audio.ts.

api.music: POST /v1/music, body { prompt, music_length_ms, model_id, output_format, force_instrumental }, returns audio bytes
api.sfx: POST /v1/sound-generation?output_format=..., body { text, duration_seconds, prompt_influence, model_id }, returns audio bytes
api.cost: neither endpoint reports a cost, so cost is measured from the usage endpoint
